LESSON: LEVERS AS SIMPLE MACHINES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Force and energy
Topic 3.2: Levers as simple machines
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Levers as simple machines, part of Force and energy in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How are levers used in our everyday life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Brainstorm in purposive pairs the meaning of levers as simple machines. Learners

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Brainstorm in purposive pairs the meaning of levers as simple machines. Learners

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Levers as simple machines together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: The learner assembles different parts and innovatively makes a beam balance from locally

available materials.

● Learning to learn: The learner learn from each other as they carry out activities as they demonstrate the use of common

levers as simple machines.

Values:
Respect: The learner displays positive regard for self and others as they work together to identify parts of a lever.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship education: The learner exercises care and protection for one another while performing experiments to demonstrate

the use of common levers as simple machines.

Link to other learning areas:

 Learner is able to link application of the principle of levers in farm tools, use of cutlery; spoons and bottle openers as in

Agriculture and Nutrition.

 Learner is able to apply the concepts of simple leavers as they play on a seesaw in creative Arts.
